item.title: Parëva™ Beauty: The Joy of Science-Backed Transformation
item.description: The first time I opened a box on my doorstep to find Parëva™ Beauty’s packaging, I did a double take. In an industry saturated with clinical whites, muted pastels, and “quiet luxury” minimalism, here was something unapologetically bold: a serum in fire-engine red, a moisturizer in cobalt blue, a primer in emerald green. It felt like skincare that wanted to be noticed.
